meta.title: Valentina Bernardi — Ski instructor in Les Arcs, Val d'Isère & Tignes
meta.description: Private, children's and family ski lessons in Les Arcs, Val d'Isère and Tignes with Valentina Bernardi. All levels, taught in English, French or Italian.

about.title: Hi, I'm Valentina.
about.p1: I've been skiing since I was four, in the Apennines in Italy. I raced until I was eighteen, then qualified as a ski instructor, and for the past {{years}} years I've been working in the Tarentaise, between Les Arcs, Val d'Isère and Tignes.
about.p2: I'm patient and enthusiastic. I teach skiers of all ages and abilities, with one goal that comes before all others: having fun on the slopes.
about.cred2: {{years}} years of experience in the Tarentaise
about.cred4: Lessons in Italian, French and English
about.imgPortrait: Valentina at the top, helmet and goggles on, mountains behind
about.imgPiste: Valentina on the piste with her pink poles

private.title: Private lesson
private.text: A lesson just for you. We start from your level and what you want to improve, and adapt the plan to the snow on the day.
private.imgAlt: Carved turn on a groomed slope

children.title: Children
children.text: We start with games, safely, until the first real turns. Lots of patience, breaks when needed and parents always kept in the loop.
children.imgAlt: Lesson with a little girl making her first turns

group.title: Group & family
group.text: For friends or families of a similar level: you ski together and everyone gets the right tips for them.
group.imgAlt: Group lesson on a wide slope

booking.note: Rates do not include the lift pass or equipment rental.

where.title: Les Arcs, Val d'Isère and Tignes
where.p1: I work in the Tarentaise valley, in Savoie, in three resorts I know well.
where.lesArcs: Part of Paradiski together with La Plagne: 425 km of runs and, on clear days, Mont Blanc right in front of you.
where.valDisere: Linked to Tignes, with around 300 km of runs. Home of the Face de Bellevarde, the 1992 Olympic downhill run.
where.tignes: Thanks to the Grande Motte glacier, the snow is good at the start and end of the season too.

reviews.title: What people say
reviews.summary: {{count}} reviews on Google and Maison Sport

items.lynne: A fantastic lesson. I really enjoyed our lesson — Valentina is very clear in her explanations and her feedback is useful and constructive. She is very friendly and easy to chat to on the lifts. I'll book again.
items.katrine: Valentina was really excellent. She taught our son a much better technique in 2×2 hours.
items.rebecca: My daughter (12) and my nephew (17) had two two-hour lessons with Valentina. She was brilliant at helping them build their confidence on the slopes and gave them tips on skiing on ice and in fresh snow. She was very relaxed and easy-going — exactly what they needed. My very experienced 14-year-old son joined them for the second lesson so that Valentina could show them some off-piste routes through the trees, which they all loved. Yesterday we all skied together and couldn't believe how much more they were enjoying themselves on the slopes: self-confidence is everything! Thank you Valentina :)
items.fiona: Valentina took my 5-year-old daughter skiing for the first time. On the first day she was skiing the lower slopes on her own, and on the second day she was skiing the blue runs at the top of the mountain. Very patient and encouraging. Highly recommended.
items.richard: Our 3 children, of different ages and abilities, had the lovely Valentina for their ski lessons for a week. They all improved considerably over the week. Thank you! She was always smiling, always ready to help with any question and to meet each child's needs. We highly recommend her.
items.claire: Valentina gave me an excellent lesson. She gave clear instructions and was very patient, with a kind and friendly approach.
items.jamesP: My partner is 67 and relatively new to skiing. Valentina was calm and clear in her instructions. As a result, my partner enjoyed her lessons and really gained confidence. We highly recommend her.
items.kate: Valentina was a wonderful instructor. She was very patient, kind and always smiling. My daughters really liked her and she made sure the lessons were fun. 😊
items.nicola: I had a couple of lessons with Valentina. She's a fantastic teacher, very kind, and explained everything really well. I felt I learned a lot in those few hours with her. Thank you!
items.janine: We had so much fun with Valentina, who took us off-piste! We felt safe and had 4 fun hours. See you next time, Valentina!
items.jamesPowell: Valentina was an excellent ski instructor, making sure my wife made good progress while having fun at the same time. We would book her again without hesitation.
items.lone: She was a good teacher for showing me how to start skiing.
